module.device_settings.title: Device settings
module.device_settings.description:
Applies every setting listed under device_settings in deploy.json, then reads each one back from the phone.
A setting only counts as done when the phone reports the expected value.
module.applications.title: Applications
module.applications.description:
For each ticked app: managed Play Store → installed → sign-in (you open the app in the Mirror, the tool types the credentials) → pinned.
The Company Portal comes first: its Enrollment creates the Work Profile.
module.final_check.title: Final check
module.final_check.description:
Reads the phone one last time: Work Profile present, ticked apps still installed.
Then shows the Checklist: what was done and what is left by hand.

mirror.title: ▌MIRROR
mirror.instructions:
To connect the phone:

1.  Settings → About phone → Software information:
     tap “Build number” 7 times.

2.  Settings → Developer options:
     turn on “USB debugging”.

3.  Plug the USB cable in, then tap “Allow”
     on the phone.
